title: Tomb Raider studio Crystal Dynamics cuts 8 more jobs
subject: tombraider
description:
What should happen to Tomb Raider next? 👇

Crystal Dynamics, the studio behind Tomb Raider, confirmed it has laid off 8 more people, at least its fifth round of cuts in under two years. The studio says no ongoing projects are affected; Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is due in February 2027 and Tomb Raider: Catalyst in 2028.

Sources: PC Gamer (Nov 17, 2026), Vertical Slice
Game footage © Crystal Dynamics / Square Enix.

scenes.text: Tomb Raider studio Crystal Dynamics has cut 8 more jobs.
Vertical Slice reported the layoffs on November 17, and the studio confirmed them to PC Gamer.
It's at least the fifth round in under 2 years, about 70 people total. The last came 8 months ago.
The studio called it a necessary business decision and says no ongoing projects are affected.
Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is still due in February 2027, and the new Catalyst is planned for 2028.
